from pathlib import Path
import json,re,sys,os
root=Path(os.environ['REPOSITORY_ROOT'])
sys.path[:0]=[str(root),str(root/'tests/embedded')]
from support.common import load_module,load_target,renode_workspace,run_renode,value
board,label=sys.argv[1:]
output=root/'out/v0270/array'/label
report={'status':'failed','board':board}
renode=Path(os.environ['RENODE'])
target=load_target(board)
platform=load_module(root/'tests/embedded/ports'/target['port']/'renode.py','array_port').Platform(target)
platform.prepare(renode,output,report)
symbols=json.loads((output/'firmware/symbols.json').read_text())
with renode_workspace(output) as (alias,temporary):
 (output/'machine.repl').write_text(platform.machine_header(alias)+('syscfg: Memory.MappedMemory @ sysbus 0x40013800\n    size: 0x400\n' if label=='nucleo' else ''))
 script=[f'logFile @{alias}/model.log','logLevel 1 file','logLevel 3 console','mach create',f'machine LoadPlatformDescription @{alias}/machine.repl',platform.load_binary(alias),'sysbus.cpu Reset','emulation RunFor "0:00:01"']
 names=['emela_board_completed','emela_board_failures','emela_board_boot_initialized']
 for name in names:script.extend([f'echo "{name}"',f'sysbus ReadDoubleWord {symbols[name]:#x}'])
 script.append('quit')
 status,log=run_renode(renode,output,alias,temporary,script,report,60)
 model=(output/'model.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
 assert not status and not re.search(r'\[ERROR\]|There was an error executing command|Unhandled Exception|Errors during compilation',log+model),log
 metrics={name:value(log,name) for name in names}
 assert list(metrics.values())==[1,0,1],metrics
 report.update(status='passed',metrics=metrics)
(output/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(board,metrics)
